cohort: The study included 329 infants with a birth weight < 1500g and gestational age less than 34 weeks, admitted to the NICU/SNCU with admission hypothermia, excluding those with major congenital abnormalities or incomplete temperature data.
finding: The study found high rates of mortality (40.93%) and RDS (87.13%) as short-term outcomes in moderate hypothermic VLBW infants, and a significant delay in mean developmental age (p=0.003) was observed in this group as a long-term outcome after one year of age.
